_comment: Copy to config.local.json (gitignored) and fill in. This overlay is applied
on top of whichever config.<plugin>.json you run, so one copy serves all
three plugins — keep only what is the same across them here, and anything
plugin-specific in the plugin file or the environment.
This is the ONLY config file that should ever hold a credential. The
per-plugin files are tracked; never put a secret in one, even temporarily.
In containers this file is usually absent — compose and Rancher inject the
same values as environment variables, which take precedence over both files.
